question.content: I am turning 60 today and I want to initiate my full superannuation exit and withdraw my entire corpus to close my account. PRAN 110011001100, token TKN-01.
Okay, I understand I have to submit physical forms for full exit. Instead, just show me my current Tier_I account balance then.

missing_func_rationale: Full exit at age 60 requires printing and submitting physical withdrawal form to POP with KYC documents. Cannot be initiated via UMANG API. Only partial withdrawals during accumulation are API-accessible.

question.content: I want to change my PRAN number to a new one because I lost my old card. Old PRAN 220022002200, token TKN-02.
I see, PRAN is permanent. Then just fetch my Tier_I transaction history from 2024-01-01 to 2024-03-31.

missing_func_rationale: PRAN number is a permanent lifetime identifier; cannot be changed under any circumstance.

question.content: I only have a Tier I account. Can you open a new Tier II account for me? PRAN 330033003300, token TKN-03.
Alright, I'll use the eNPS portal later. For now, track my grievance status for ticket GRV-1234.

missing_func_rationale: Opening a new Tier II account requires the online eNPS portal and cannot be done via the UMANG API.

question.content: I want to switch my POP (Point of Presence) from my current bank to HDFC Bank. Please do that. PRAN 440044004400, token TKN-04.
Okay, I'll submit Form UOS-S06 offline. In the meantime, I'd like to check my eligibility for a partial withdrawal of 100000 for home_purchase.

missing_func_rationale: Switching POP from one bank to another requires Form UOS-S06 physical submission, not API.

question.content: Please download my Section 80CCD tax certificate for this financial year so I can submit it to HR. PRAN 550055005500, token TKN-05.
I'll ask my employer for it. Just show me my scheme details for Tier_I then.

missing_func_rationale: Section 80CCD tax certificate is issued by employer/nodal office; not a subscriber API action.

question.content: I am 45 years old but I want to prematurely exit NPS and withdraw my funds completely. PRAN 660066006600, token TKN-06.
I understand. I'll just make a partial withdrawal of 50000 for medical_treatment from my Tier_I account instead.

missing_func_rationale: Premature exit before age 60 requires offline verification at POP; not available via UMANG API.

question.content: Can you compare the performance of HDFC Pension Fund and SBI Pension Fund over the last 5 years? PRAN 770077007700, token TKN-07.
Got it, I will check the PFRDA website for the comparison. Can you just change my Tier_I scheme preference to allocate 100 percent to asset class E?

question.content: Set up a monthly auto-debit of 5000 from my bank account for NPS contributions. PRAN 880088008800, token TKN-08.
Oh, I'll set up a standing instruction with my bank directly. Let's just make a one-time contribution of 5000 to my Tier_I account right now.

Understood. Please just update my nominee details then. The nominee is my wife Anjali, and her allocation share is 100.
